description:
Storage and style come together in the Mackenzie 6 Drawer Dresser. Six dovetailed drawers with full-extension glides offer generous space for clothing, bedding, and nursery essentials, all within a beautiful solid hardwood frame finished in warm Brown Maple.

The flat top is perfectly sized for a changing pad, creating a convenient diaper station. Non-toxic, baby-safe finishes throughout. Coordinates with the complete Mackenzie collection for a cohesive nursery look that lasts from baby through big-kid years.

If you would like help choosing a finish, confirming timing, or picturing how this piece fits your nursery plans, use Get Personal Assistance. We reply the same or next business day so you can decide with full information, at your own pace.
